actions.text: The EU’s new AI framework is a necessary step toward responsible deployment — it clarifies risk classification and accountability in ways that will push companies to bake safety and transparency into their products from the start. For tech firms, compliance will mean rethinking data governance, model documentation, and post-deployment monitoring, but it also creates opportunities: strong compliance can become a competitive differentiator and build user trust. My hope is regulators and industry keep iterating together so rules stay useful against fast-moving capabilities while avoiding overly prescriptive requirements that stifle innovation.
